en.headline: Three-year-old boy critically ill with influenza complications
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child, who has a chronic illness and visited the United States during the incubation period, remains in intensive care at Tuen Mun Hospital.
body: The Centre for Health Protection recorded a severe paediatric influenza case involving a three-year-old boy with a chronic illness who developed complications including acute asthma attack, acute necrotising encephalopathy and septic shock.

According to the Centre, the boy developed fever and cough from Tuesday, sought private treatment the next day, and was admitted to Tuen Mun Hospital’s emergency department on Thursday after his condition deteriorated and he briefly lost consciousness. He is now in the paediatric intensive care unit and remains critically ill.

Preliminary investigation showed he had visited the United States during the incubation period and had not received the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine. The Centre said this is the 26th severe paediatric influenza case this season, with two still critically ill and two deaths recorded so far.

zh.headline: 三歲男童感染流感併發嚴重併發症情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，這名有長期病患的男童潛伏期曾到美國，目前仍在屯門醫院兒童深切治療部留醫。
body: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案，涉及一名有長期病患的三歲男童，併發哮喘急性發作、急性壞死性腦病變和敗血性休克。
中心指，男童自周二起發燒及咳嗽，翌日到私家診所求診，周四病情惡化被帶到屯門醫院急症室，一度失去意識，經搶救後入住兒童深切治療部，目前情況危殆。
初步調查顯示，男童潛伏期內曾到美國，未接種2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗。中心表示，本流感季節已錄得26宗兒童嚴重個案，其中兩宗情況危殆、兩宗死亡。
